verdict.line: You lose if you fight into Shen's Q (Vorpal Blade) sustain and E (Shadow Dash) taunt back-to-back; you win if you force him to commit inside your W (Hallowed Mist) and punish his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Shen has no way to threaten Gwen at range and no way to target her at all unless he physically walks into Hallowed Mist, so he's forced to either all-in on cooldown or concede the trade. The matchup is decided by whether Gwen punishes the windows when Shen's Q (Vorpal Blade) sustain and E (Shadow Dash) taunt are down, which the 51.8% win rate over 1080 games reflects as a slight Gwen edge rather than a clean favor.

theirWindow.when: Q (Vorpal Blade) and E (Shadow Dash) both up
theirWindow.what: Shen can taunt you from 575 range then chain Q's 475-range life tap to heal off the trade. Don't stand in E's dash path and don't contest minions he's using Q on.

yourWindow.when: Shen's E (Shadow Dash) is down (8-16s CD)
yourWindow.what: He has no taunt to lock you in, so step up and all-in with Q (Snip Snip!) cone plus E (Skip 'n Slash) empowered autos. His only answer is Feint (W), which is a 5-9s cooldown self-shield, not a damage source.

powerCurve.note: Neither has burst; wave management only
Shadow Dash taunt plus Vorpal Blade sustain online
Your Q cooldown drops, E refund trades back

His global R enables teleports, items keep you relevant

start.why: The 53.5% win rate over 1159 games build (plus two Health Potions) gives mana and sustain to out-trade his Q (Vorpal Blade) poke without going even on health.

boots.why: 57.3% win rate over 562 games; Shen has no innate magic resist tools, so flat penetration lets your Q cone and passive procs hit harder through his Feint (W) shield once it's down.

core.why: First item in the 63.3% win rate, 237-game path; builds your snowball before he can stabilize with Feint and Vorpal Blade sustain
Second item in the same path; the burst spike lines up with the 9-13 power window where you want to force fights
Closes out the 63.3% win rate path; maximizes the burst that Shen's Feint can only delay, not prevent

situational.when: the game goes long and you need sustained damage over a third burst item
the enemy team has dive potential that can reach you after Shen's E (Shadow Dash) taunt lands
you want more attack speed to maximize E (Skip 'n Slash)'s empowered on-hit window

runes.keystoneWhy: Shen can't burst you off a single trade, so stacking adaptive force across the extended skirmishes this lane produces wins the war of attrition his Q sustain is trying to fight.

summoners.why: The 56.5% win rate Flash+Ignite build is the main pick (61.2% pick rate) because Shen has no hard engage beyond the E (Shadow Dash) taunt and no way to heal through Ignite's burn once you land a trade; Flash+Teleport (45.4% win rate, 17.8% pick) is the alternative when you need to contest his teleport-driven map pressure.

playing.title: Bait Shadow Dash before trading
playing.detail: Shen's E (Shadow Dash) is his only way to lock you down; if you see him walk up without it on cooldown, hold your trade until he either uses it on a minion or you've repositioned out of its 575 range.

playing.title: Force him into your Mist
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist (W) means Shen literally cannot target you unless he walks in. Use it to bait his E (Shadow Dash) commitment and then punish him with Q (Snip Snip!) while he's stuck inside.

playing.title: Trade when Feint is down
playing.detail: Feint (W) absorbs incoming damage for a few seconds on a 5-9s cooldown. Track his last cast and only commit your E (Skip 'n Slash) all-in when it's on cooldown.

playing.title: Don't fight through his Q sustain
playing.detail: Vorpal Blade (Q) heals allies who attack the target on a 4-6s cooldown, so prolonged auto-trades favor him. Burst with Q cone and E empowered autos instead of extended auto-attack exchanges.

playing.title: Play wave state around his global ult
playing.detail: Stand United (R) lets Shen shield and teleport to any ally on a 160-200s cooldown. Keep the wave pushed into him or frozen near your turret so a Shen roam doesn't let him recall and ult into a side lane for free.

playing.title: Rank R for poke, not all-ins
playing.detail: Needlework (R) slows and applies your passive at 1200 range with up to two extra casts; use it to poke him off CS or secure picks under tower rather than as a burst finisher, since Shen has no kill pressure to punish you for using mana on it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (OP.GG); the mechanical reasoning about cooldown windows and trade patterns is my own tactical read, not sourced data.
